caregivers.name: Pandu R.
caregivers.experienceDetails: 5 years of caring for senior citizens

services.title: Elderly Care at Home
services.short: Compassionate, respectful care for seniors in the comfort of home.
services.description: Trained caregivers assist your elderly loved ones with daily activities, mobility, medication reminders, meals, and companionship — always with dignity and warmth.

services.title: Mother & Baby Care
services.short: Postnatal support for new mothers and their newborns.
services.description: Experienced maternity attendants and nurses help new mothers with recovery, feeding guidance, baby bathing, and round-the-clock newborn care.

services.title: Pregnancy Care
services.short: Attentive prenatal support for expectant mothers at home.
services.description: Qualified nurses provide antenatal check-ins, wellness monitoring, and comforting care throughout pregnancy — so you can rest, recover and prepare in peace.

services.title: Newborn Baby Care
services.short: Specialist care for babies in their most delicate first weeks.
services.description: Trained newborn caregivers handle feeding, sleep routines, bathing, and gentle massages so parents can rest while their little one is in expert hands.

services.title: Home Nursing Services
services.short: Qualified nurses delivering hospital-grade care at home.
services.description: Registered nurses provide wound care, IV therapy, catheter care, tracheostomy care, and general nursing tailored to your medical needs.

services.title: Injection Services
services.short: Safe, sterile injections administered by trained nurses at home.
services.description: On-demand injection service for insulin, antibiotics, vitamin shots, and prescribed medication — quick, hygienic, and pain-conscious.

services.title: Post-Surgery Care
services.short: Guided recovery care after hospital discharge.
services.description: Nurses and attendants support post-operative healing with wound care, medication schedules, mobility help, and gentle physical support.

services.title: Patient Care Attendant
services.short: Dedicated attendants for personal and daily patient needs.
services.description: Trained attendants assist with feeding, hygiene, positioning and companionship so families can focus on being together.

services.title: Bedridden Patient Care
services.short: Specialist care for patients confined to bed.
services.description: Attendants and nurses trained in bedsore prevention, position changes, sponge baths, catheter care, and full daily support for bedridden patients.

services.title: ICU / Home Recovery Support
services.short: ICU-level home support for critical recovery.
services.description: Critical-care trained nurses handle ventilator monitoring, tracheostomy care, and intensive recovery routines under doctor guidance.

services.title: Physiotherapy
services.short: Home physiotherapy sessions for recovery and mobility.
services.description: Professional physiotherapists visit your home for orthopaedic, neurological and post-surgery rehabilitation programs.

services.title: Doctor Consultation
services.short: Home visit and online consultations with trusted doctors.
services.description: Consult experienced general physicians and specialists from the comfort of your home — with follow-ups and prescriptions.

faqs.question: Are your caregivers and nurses verified?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every professional undergoes ID verification, background checks, and skill assessments before joining.

faqs.question: How quickly can care be arranged?
faqs.answer: In most cities, we can arrange care within 4–12 hours depending on the service and shift.

faqs.question: Can I choose the shift duration?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We offer hourly visits, 12-hour and 24-hour shifts, plus weekly and monthly plans.

faqs.question: How do payments work?
faqs.answer: You can pay online via Razorpay. Shift booking is confirmed immediately after secure payment.

faqs.question: What if I need to reschedule or cancel?
faqs.answer: You can reschedule anytime via your dashboard panel. Cancellations follow our refund policy.
